subject: Proposal: Convert transient burst to short-term reserved slab + overrun reconciliation
messages:
From: Samir Kaur <samir@alphaops.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T16:14:22Z
Subject: Short notice: launch week surge and next steps for billing

Kimberly / Laura —

Thanks again for the quick ramp last week. We pushed three new features on Friday and saw a 6x spike in inference calls overnight. The platform handled it great, but we expect similar burst behavior over the next 10 days as we finish the rollout.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood convert the transient burst we used (approx 1.2M tokens/day peak) into a short-term reserved slab for the next 30 days so we get a predictable unit rate?
2) How will the March overrun true-up be handled if we move to a temporary slab mid-month — any pro-rated pricing or credits?

I pulled export slices and attached "alphaops_usage_export.csv" for your finance team. We have an internal PO but need a clear path for procurement and a short-term contract amendment if possible.

Best,
Samir
VP Product, AlphaOps
[Attachment: alphaops_usage_export.csv (csv, 78KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kaur <samir@alphaops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T18:02:03Z
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week surge and next steps for billing

Samir —

Appreciate the heads up and the export — useful context. Short answer: we can convert the transient burst into a 30-day reserved slab that effectively normalizes your unit token price for that window, and we can apply a pro-rated true-up for March so you don't get hit with both an overrun invoice and a new slab charge.

Proposed operational play (high level):
- Create a 30-day reserved slab (start date TBD, we should sync on the exact midnight UTC boundary) sized at the observed 95th percentile for the last 72 hours.
- Apply a one-time pro-rata credit to cancel overrun charges incurred before the slab becomes active — that means we compute the March overrun, subtract the portion covered by the slab effective date, and issue a credit on the following invoice.
- If you want a firm rate for the 30-day slab we can offer a temporary blended unit price (about 12% below standard paygo for that month) in exchange for the short-term commit.

I've attached a draft amendment that frames this as a temporary committed slab with an automatic revert to pay-as-you-go at the end of 30 days (no lock-in). See "proposed-amendment.docx".

Ben / Laura — can you review the rate guidance and confirm if the blended discount is doable and whether finance can apply the pro-rated true-up credit flow? Samir, if that structure works I can get a signed amendment and PO routing started today.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-amendment.docx (docx, 42KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Kaur <samir@alphaops.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T09:41:57Z
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week surge and next steps for billing

Kim / Samir —

This is reasonable. Two commercial notes:
- I can approve a short-term blended rate but would like to tie the discount to a minimum slab size (to avoid a tiny commit getting a large discount). Looking at Samir's export, a 30-day slab at 1.8M tokens/day (rounded to nearest 50k) should be the floor.
- If AlphaOps can commit to a nominal PO for the slab within 24 hours, we can apply the 12% blended discount and expedite amendment signing. Without a PO we can still provision the slab but the discount would drop to 6% and the pro-rated true-up still applies.

Samir — let me know if AlphaOps can get a quick PO over. If yes, I'll confirm the final unit price and route to finance to create the proforma.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kaur <samir@alphaops.com>, AlphaOps Billing <billing@alphaops.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T11:05:10Z
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week surge and next steps for billing

Folks —

Finance reviewed the usage export. Operational notes for reconciliation:
- We'll compute the March overrun using daily token tallies. If the slab activates on 2028-03-04T00:00:00Z we will:
  * Invoice overrun for 2028-03-01 through 2028-03-03 as usual; then issue a credit for the portion covered by the slab effective 03-04.
  * Apply the slab charge (pro-rated for March) on the next billing cycle invoice and net the credit there.
- I've uploaded a proforma ("proforma-invoice.pdf") that shows two scenarios: PO received within 24h (12% blended rate) and PO not received (6% blended rate).

Action items:
- Samir: confirm PO timing and slab start date (we recommend 2028-03-04 00:00:00Z to align with your deployment cadence).
- Ben: if PO arrives, confirm final slab sizing (I used 1.8M tokens/day in the proforma).
- Kim: I'll prepare the invoice schedule and mark the credit flow so the customer's accounting team sees the net.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proforma-invoice.pdf (pdf, 64KB)]
